instruction: I am going on a vacation. Move my wake-up phone alarm to 40 minutes earlier and disable the rest.
notes: Single app (phone); exactly one action per reference API. The type formerly named alarm-time collided with a predicate name, so the type is now time-value and the alarm state is the single predicate (alarm-setting ?alarm ?time ?enabled). phone.update_alarm is one action that always passes both optional fields: for the wake-up alarm time = original - 40 min and enabled = its current value; for every other enabled alarm time = its current value and enabled = false. Re-passing a current value leaves that DB field unchanged, so the changed-field sets are exactly {time} for the wake-up alarm and {enabled} for the others, as the evaluation requires; combining both fields in one state atom also avoids delete/add conflicts on the same atom. The static (time-arg ?al ?old ?new) / (enabled-arg ?al ?old ?new) facts encode the instruction (40 minutes earlier; disable the rest) and make each update applicable exactly once per alarm. phone.show_alarms sets (alarms-listed), which gates all updates since ids and current times are only known after listing. The number of other enabled alarms is unknown a priori: two placeholder alarms are used and one update call is made per enabled non-wake-up alarm found at runtime (already-disabled alarms need no call). All goal conditions are per-alarm facts that cannot be stated without quantification, so supervisor-complete-task's precondition is (not (task-completed)); because every other action requires (not (task-completed)) and the goal demands the updated alarm settings, any valid plan performs all updates first and ends with complete_task. No answer is passed since the task asks no question.

warnings: supervisor-complete-task precondition does not require the task's goal conditions

plan: (phone-update-alarm alarm-wake-up phone-token time-wake-up-minus-40 enabled-wake-up-current time-wake-up-original enabled-wake-up-current)

(phone-update-alarm alarm-other-1 phone-token time-other-1 enabled-false time-other-1 enabled-true)
